title: The tally crashes on unreadable input
what: tally.py prints a traceback on unreadable input and exits 1 (a bar is exceeded) instead of 2 (not judged).
why: A tally that crashes reads as 'a bar is exceeded', a wrong answer about the judge.
failing_case: `python3 tally.py /dev/null --expect-model haiku` prints a traceback and exits 1, which means "a bar is exceeded"; should exit 2, "not judged" (L1)
